summary: IMM 5257, “Application for Visitor Visa (Temporary Resident Visa)”, is the form from Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) that asks who you are, what your passport says, why and for how long you want to visit Canada, and a set of background questions. Each person who applies for a visitor visa fills in one, and it is completed on a computer with Adobe Acrobat Reader.
